title: Beautiful item, poor packaging
text: Beautiful item, poor packaging. Loved the style and product feature which included a crumb catcher. Unfortunately, as other reviewers indicated, it arrived with the glass tray in pieces. Had to return.

product_metadata.title: CKS Kilo Chrome Victorian 6 Slice Slot Breakfast Toast Rack with Frosted Glass Base and Handle BA87
features: Very sturdy and hard wearing construction which also adds an elegant and stylish touch to your breakfast table. Complete with frosted white base.
Specially designed 6 slice slot bread holder is perfect for keeping the toast crisp and preventing it from going soggy.
Ergonomic handle for easy carrying the cooked toast from the toaster to the family breakfast dining table.
High quality shiny chrome, easy to clean and dishwasher safe, store near toaster ready for using. Size 15 x 8 x 15cm / 6 " x 3 " x 6 " inches
